summary: MSc Data Science student at FAU Erlangen-Nürnberg who treats output quality as a measurement problem. Built an ATS Resume Checker on large language models, designed the prompts and embedding-based retrieval behind it, deployed it against Google Vertex AI managed endpoints, and set up evaluation loops to measure and improve output quality. Delivered 10+ production-ready models in Python at Elevate Labs and was recognised as Best Performer of the cohort, including a Walmart weekly-sales forecasting model at 96.1% R² that reduced forecast error by 18%. Co-author of a peer-reviewed deep-learning paper (ICISD 2025, Atlantis Press) reporting 95.79% mAP@0.5 and 93.75% accuracy.

bullets: Recognised as Best Performer of the cohort across 8 end-to-end machine learning projects, delivering 10+ production-ready models in Python and evaluating each one on the metric that matched its failure mode: ROC-AUC, R², mAP or silhouette score.
Built a Walmart weekly-sales forecasting model with XGBoost reaching 96.1% R² and reducing forecast error by 18%.
Ran an automated hyperparameter search with GridSearchCV over a Support Vector Machine, achieving 95%+ ROC-AUC, and applied the elbow method to select k for K-Nearest-Neighbours classification.

Delivered classification and regression models across medical and commercial datasets: breast-cancer diagnosis with Logistic Regression at 96%+ accuracy, heart-disease prediction with Decision Trees and Random Forests, and housing-price prediction above 0.90 R².

Segmented 200 customers into 5 clusters with K-Means at a silhouette score of 0.55, and ran Titanic dataset exploratory data analysis covering distribution analysis, missing-value treatment and feature relationships.
Set up evaluation loops on Google Vertex AI to measure and improve the output quality of a large language model application.
Designed and iterated LLM prompts and embedding-based retrieval, then deployed the application against Vertex AI managed endpoints.
Built an ATS Resume Checker powered by large language models, parsing resumes, scoring them against job descriptions and returning structured feedback.
Set up monitoring for cloud workloads and automated infrastructure tasks across VMware virtualisation infrastructure.
Applied and enforced security guidelines across managed environments.

Built an American Sign Language image-recognition system with a Convolutional Neural Network in PyTorch, implementing the full training, validation and inference pipeline with data augmentation to improve generalisation.

publications.description: Deep-learning surveillance for prison environments on live CCTV feeds. Reported results: 95.79% mAP@0.5 with precision and recall both at 0.93, and 93.75% accuracy for face recognition.
